synonyms: gross merchandise value; webshop sales; order value; AOV
short_definition: Value of placed webshop orders (delivered or returned, never cancelled), net of VAT, EUR; AOV = GMV / placed orders.
Returned orders / placed orders (delivered + returned), in percent.
A shopper with at least one placed order in the last 12 months (2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30).
